Looking at the failures, both are about escaped pipe (`\|`) cell content expectations. The tests expect a space before `\|` in the cell content that doesn't exist in the input.

For `test_r14_escaped_pipe_preserved`: Input `| p\|q | r |` has cell content `p\|q` (no space between `p` and `\|`), but the test expects `p \|q` (with space). The test is wrong.

For `test_integration_tab_whitespace_escaped_pipe`: The data row `| \t x\|y  z | w |` — after `parse_row_cells` strips leading whitespace (including the tab and space before `x`), the cell is `x\|y  z` (no space between `x` and `\|`). After normalization it becomes `x\|y z`. But the test expects `x \|y z` (with space). The test is wrong.

I'll fix the test assertions to match the correct expected values.

<<<FILE tests/test_outputs.py>>>
import subprocess
import pytest
import os
import tempfile


def run_mdtbl(args=None, input_text=None):
    """Run mdtbl and return (stdout, stderr, returncode)."""
    cmd = ['/app/mdtbl']
    if args:
        cmd.extend(args)
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        input=input_text,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    return result.stdout, result.stderr, result.returncode


def parse_output_cells(line):
    """Parse a markdown table row from mdtbl output, respecting \\| as escaped pipe."""
    stripped = line.strip()
    if stripped.startswith('|'):
        stripped = stripped[1:]
    if stripped.endswith('|'):
        stripped = stripped[:-1]
    placeholder = '\x01'
    stripped = stripped.replace('\\|', placeholder)
    cells = [c.replace(placeholder, '\\|').strip() for c in stripped.split('|')]
    return cells


# ===== R1: Cell padding =====

def test_r1_padding_default():
    """Default padding is 1 space each side."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n| x |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data_line = lines[2]
    # Col width 3 (min), padding 1, content 'x' left-aligned
    # Cell: ' x   ' (space, x, 2 spaces, space) -> between pipes
    parts = data_line.split('|')
    # parts: ['', ' x   ', '']
    cell = parts[1]
    assert cell[0] == ' '  # 1 space padding on left
    assert cell[-1] == ' '  # 1 space padding on right


def test_r1_empty_cell():
    """Empty cell has exactly 1 space padding on each side of content area."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n|  |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data_line = lines[2]
    parts = data_line.split('|')
    cell = parts[1]
    # Empty cell in width-3 column: padding + 3 spaces + padding = 5 spaces
    assert cell[0] == ' '
    assert cell[-1] == ' '
    assert cell.strip() == ''


def test_r1_compact_no_padding():
    """--compact removes all cell padding."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n| x |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--compact'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    # Delimiter: |---|
    assert lines[1] == '|---|'
    # Data: |x  | (no padding, left-aligned in width 3)
    data = lines[2]
    parts = data.split('|')
    cell = parts[1]
    assert cell[0] == 'x'  # No leading space


# ===== R2: Display width =====

def test_r2_cjk_korean():
    """Korean characters (Hangul) count as width 2."""
    inp = "| \uc774\ub984 | nm |\n| --- | --- |\n| Kim | ab |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    # \uc774\ub984 = 2 Hangul syllables, display width 4
    # nm = width 2
    # Col 1 width = max(4, 3) = 4 (Kim=3)
    # Col 2 width = max(2, 2) = 2, min 3 -> 3
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    delim = lines[1]
    parts = delim.split('|')
    # Col 1 delimiter: 4 dashes
    assert parts[1].strip() == '----'
    # Col 2 delimiter: 3 dashes
    assert parts[2].strip() == '---'


def test_r2_katakana():
    """Katakana characters count as width 2."""
    # \u30a1 = Katakana small a, in U+3040-U+30FF range
    inp = "| \u30a1 | a |\n| --- | --- |\n| x | y |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    # \u30a1 width 2, 'a' width 1
    # Col 1 width = max(2, 1) = 2, min 3 -> 3
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    delim = lines[1]
    parts = delim.split('|')
    assert parts[1].strip() == '---'

# ===== R7: Numeric detection =====

def test_r7_numeric_column():
    """Column with all numeric data cells is detected as numeric."""

    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)

    delim = lines[1]
    parts = delim.split('|')
    col2_delim = parts[2].strip()
    assert col2_delim.endswith(':')

    score_cell = parts1[2]

def test_r8_header_center():
    """Numeric column header is center-aligned."""
    inp = "| Price |\n| --- |\n| 12345 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    parts = header.split('|')
    # Col width = max(5, 5) = 5
    # 'Price' centered in width 5: space=0, so just 'Price'
    # With padding: ' Price '
    assert parts[1].strip() == 'Price'


def test_r8_center_odd_padding():
    """Header center-alignment with non-zero space."""
    inp = "| Val |\n| --- |\n| 123456 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    parts = header.split('|')
    # Col width = max(3, 6) = 6
    # Header 'Val' centered: space = 3, lp = 1, rp = 2
    cell = parts[1]
    # Strip gives 'Val'
    assert cell.strip() == 'Val'
    # Check that there's more whitespace on the right than left of 'Val'
    left_of_val = cell[:cell.index('V')]
    right_of_val = cell[cell.index('l') + 1:]
    # left = 2 spaces (pad+lp), right = 3 spaces (rp+pad)
    assert len(right_of_val) > len(left_of_val)


# ===== R9: Number normalization =====

def test_r9_normalization():
    """Numbers in numeric columns are normalized."""
    inp = "| Val |\n| --- |\n| +0.10 |\n| 2.0 |\n| +99 |\n| -0.25 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    # After normalization: +0.10->0.1, 2.0->2, +99->99, -0.25->-0.25
    data_values = []
    for line in lines[2:]:
        cell = line.split('|')[1].strip()
        data_values.append(cell)
    assert '0.1' in data_values
    assert '2' in data_values
    assert '99' in data_values
    assert '-0.25' in data_values
    # Ensure old forms are gone
    assert '+0.10' not in out
    assert '2.0' not in out
    assert '+99' not in out


def test_r9_edge_zero():
    """0.0 -> 0, +0 -> 0."""
    inp = "| Val |\n| --- |\n| 0.0 |\n| +0 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    for line in lines[2:]:
        cell = line.split('|')[1].strip()
        assert cell == '0'


# ===== R10: Sort =====

def test_r10_case_insensitive_sort():
    """Text columns sort case-insensitively."""
    inp = "| Name |\n| --- |\n| Delta |\n| alpha |\n| Gamma |\n| beta |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--sort', '1'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data = [lines[i].split('|')[1].strip() for i in range(2, len(lines))]
    assert data == ['alpha', 'beta', 'Delta', 'Gamma']


def test_r10_numeric_sort():
    """Numeric columns sort by value, not lexicographic."""
    inp = "| Val |\n| --- |\n| 2.5 |\n| 10 |\n| 0.3 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--sort', '1'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data = [lines[i].split('|')[1].strip() for i in range(2, len(lines))]
    assert data == ['0.3', '2.5', '10']


# ===== R11: Sort descending =====

def test_r11_sort_desc():
    """--sort-desc reverses sort order."""
    inp = "| Name |\n| --- |\n| Delta |\n| alpha |\n| Gamma |\n| beta |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--sort', '1', '--sort-desc'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data = [lines[i].split('|')[1].strip() for i in range(2, len(lines))]
    assert data == ['Gamma', 'Delta', 'beta', 'alpha']


def test_r11_sort_desc_alone():
    """--sort-desc without --sort has no effect."""
    inp = "| Name |\n| --- |\n| Delta |\n| alpha |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--sort-desc'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    data = [lines[i].split('|')[1].strip() for i in range(2, len(lines))]
    assert data == ['Delta', 'alpha']


# ===== R12: Tab expansion =====

def test_r12_tab():
    """Tab is replaced with 4 spaces, then whitespace normalized."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n| foo\tbar |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    cell = lines[2].split('|')[1].strip()
    assert cell == 'foo bar'


def test_r12_multiple_tabs():
    """Multiple consecutive tabs become 8 spaces then collapse to 1."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n|\t\tb |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    cell = lines[2].split('|')[1].strip()
    assert cell == 'b'


# ===== R13: Whitespace normalization =====

def test_r13_whitespace_collapse():
    """Internal whitespace is collapsed to single space."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n|   foo   bar   |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    cell = lines[2].split('|')[1].strip()
    assert cell == 'foo bar'


def test_r13_all_whitespace_cell():
    """All-whitespace cell becomes empty."""
    inp = "| A |\n| --- |\n|     |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    cell = lines[2].split('|')[1].strip()
    assert cell == ''


# ===== R14: Escaped pipe =====

def test_r14_escaped_pipe_preserved():
    r"""\| is preserved in output and not treated as cell separator."""
    inp = "| p\\|q | r |\n| --- | --- |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    cells = parse_output_cells(header)
    # Should have 2 cells
    assert len(cells) == 2
    assert '\\|' in cells[0]
    assert cells[0] == 'p\\|q'
    assert cells[1] == 'r'


def test_r14_escaped_pipe_width():
    r"""\| counts as display width 1."""
    inp = "| x\\|y\\|z |\n| --- | --- |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    delim = lines[1]
    # x\|y\|z: display width 5 (x,pipe,y,pipe,z)
    parts = delim.split('|')
    assert parts[1].strip() == '-----'


# ===== R15: Row consistency =====

def test_r15_extra_cells_merged():
    """Extra cells are merged into last column with space."""
    inp = "| A | B | C |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| x | y | z | w | v |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    parts = lines[2].split('|')
    # 3 columns -> 5 pipe-separated parts
    assert len(parts) == 5
    # Last cell should contain 'z w v'
    last_cell = parts[3].strip()
    assert last_cell == 'z w v'


def test_r15_short_row_padded():
    """Short rows are padded with empty cells."""
    inp = "| A | B | C | D |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| x |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    parts = lines[2].split('|')
    # 4 columns -> 6 pipe-separated parts
    assert len(parts) == 6
    assert 'x' in parts[1]
    for i in [2, 3, 4]:
        assert parts[i].strip() == ''


# ===== R16: Multiple tables =====

def test_r16_multi_table():
    """All tables are formatted and non-table lines preserved."""
    inp = ("| A |\n| --- |\n| x |\n\nSome text\n\n"
           "| B |\n| --- |\n| y |\n\nEnd\n")
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    assert 'Some text' in out
    assert 'End' in out
    assert 'x' in out
    assert 'y' in out
    # Check two delimiter rows (two tables)
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    delim_count = sum(1 for l in lines if l.strip().startswith('|') and '-' in l and set(l.replace('|', '').replace(' ', '').replace('-', '')) == set())
    # Actually, just check both formatted tables are present
    assert sum(1 for l in lines if '---' in l) >= 2

# ===== R17: Truncation =====

def test_r17_unicode_ellipsis():
    """Truncation uses Unicode ellipsis, not ASCII dots."""
    inp = "| Greetings |\n| --- |\n| Hello |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--max-width', '7'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    # 'Greetings' (width 9) -> truncated
    assert '\u2026' in out
    assert '...' not in out


def test_r17_truncation_logic():
    """Truncation shows N-1 chars then ellipsis."""
    inp = "| ABCDEFGHI |\n| --- |\n| x |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--max-width', '5'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    cell = header.split('|')[1].strip()
    # 'ABCDEFGHI' (width 9) with max-width 5:
    # avail = 4, take 4 chars 'ABCD', then ellipsis
    assert cell == 'ABCD\u2026'


def test_r17_cjk_truncation():
    """CJK char that doesn't fit before ellipsis shows just ellipsis."""
    # \u6f22 = CJK ideograph, width 2
    # With --max-width 1, the cell (width 2) exceeds max-width 1
    # avail = 1-1 = 0, first char width 2 > 0, show just ellipsis
    inp = "| \u6f22 |\n| --- |\n| x |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--max-width', '1'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    cell = header.split('|')[1].strip()
    assert cell == '\u2026'

def test_preserved_compact():
    """--compact removes all padding."""

    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--compact'], input_text=inp)

    data = lines[2]
    assert data.startswith('|x')

def test_preserved_no_header():
    """--no-header treats first row as data, header row is empty cells."""
    inp = "| A | B |\n| --- | --- |\n| x | y |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--no-header'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    # Header row should have empty cells
    header = lines[0]
    parts = header.split('|')
    for p in parts[1:-1]:
        assert p.strip() == ''
    # Both original rows appear as data
    assert len(lines) == 4  # header + delimiter + 2 data rows


# ===== Preserved: --align =====

def test_preserved_align_override():
    """--align overrides auto-detected alignment."""
    inp = "| Name | Score |\n| --- | --- |\n| Alice | 95 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--align', 'l,l'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    delim = lines[1]
    parts = delim.split('|')
    col2_delim = parts[2].strip()
    # With --align l,l, col 2 should be left-aligned despite numeric data
    assert not col2_delim.endswith(':')


# ===== Preserved: --input =====

def test_preserved_input_file(tmp_path):
    """--input reads from the named file."""
    f = tmp_path / "test.md"
    f.write_text("| A |\n| --- |\n| x |\n")
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--input', str(f)])
    assert rc == 0
    assert 'x' in out


# ===== Preserved: --check =====

def test_preserved_check():
    """--check validates table structure without reformatting."""
    inp = "| A | B |\n| --- | --- |\n| x |\n"
    _, err, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--check'], input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    # Should report that row 3 has wrong cell count
    assert err.strip() != ''


# ===== Preserved: --version =====

def test_preserved_version():
    """--version prints version string."""
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--version'])
    assert rc == 0
    assert '1.2.0' in out


# ===== Preserved: exit code =====

def test_preserved_exit_code_error():
    """Exit code 1 on error (file not found)."""
    _, _, rc = run_mdtbl(args=['--input', '/nonexistent'])
    assert rc == 1


# ===== Integration: combined rules =====

def test_integration_numeric_with_normalization_and_alignment():
    """Numeric column with values requiring normalization, right-aligned data, center header."""
    inp = "| Item | Price |\n| --- | --- |\n| A | +0.10 |\n| B | 100.0 |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    # Col 2 is numeric
    delim = lines[1]
    parts = delim.split('|')
    assert parts[2].strip().endswith(':')
    # Check normalized values appear
    data1_cell = lines[2].split('|')[2].strip()
    data2_cell = lines[3].split('|')[2].strip()
    assert data1_cell == '0.1'
    assert data2_cell == '100'


def test_integration_tab_whitespace_escaped_pipe():
    r"""Tab expansion, whitespace normalization, and escaped pipes together."""
    inp = "| a\t\\|b  c | d |\n| --- | --- |\n| \t x\\|y  z | w |\n"
    out, _, rc = run_mdtbl(input_text=inp)
    assert rc == 0
    lines = out.strip().split('\n')
    # Header col 1: 'a\t\|b  c' -> tab->4 spaces -> 'a    \|b  c'
    # -> strip -> 'a    \|b  c' -> collapse whitespace -> 'a \|b c'
    # Display width: a(1) + space(1) + \|(1) + b(1) + space(1) + c(1) = 6
    header_cells = parse_output_cells(lines[0])
    assert header_cells[0] == 'a \\|b c'
    # Data col 1: leading whitespace (tab+space) stripped by parse_row_cells,
    # so cell is 'x\|y  z' -> collapse whitespace -> 'x\|y z'
    # No space between 'x' and '\|' because none existed in the content
    data_cells = parse_output_cells(lines[2])
    assert data_cells[0] == 'x\\|y z'
